scene.summary: Pulseless VT. No clinical questions. AAC protected in place. No airway replacement. Clinician-controlled rescue only — no doses, energies, or gesture CPR in this content.

dialogue.speaker: Team lead
dialogue.line: Override. Protect the device. Do not replace the airway. Work the circulation pathway.

captions: Emergency override active. Non-urgent planning hidden. Educational boundary: no shock energy values.

clinicalTruth.airway: Current route remains; replacement is forbidden during this override without separate indication.
clinicalTruth.breathing: Ventilation support continues under clinical control; circuit swap is not the rescue action.
clinicalTruth.circulation: Pulseless VT pathway under clinician-controlled defibrillation readiness only.
clinicalTruth.communicationAccess: Device protected and visible; no new questions during rescue.

visibleEvidence.label: Pulseless VT pathway
visibleEvidence.detail: Emergency override engaged. No medication doses or energy figures are shown.

visibleEvidence.label: AAC protected
visibleEvidence.detail: Access equipment stays in place even while questions are deferred.

hiddenState.primaryCause: Deferred until after provisional ROSC and reassessment.
notes: Rescue success is provisional until independently confirmed.

communicationBeat.note: No questions during rescue. Protection is not the same as asking.

familyBeat.note: Family are not assigned compressions, airway, or monitoring tasks.

exitConditions.description: Rescue yields a provisional return of circulation.
